name: A four-sword combo attacking to the right, then recovery. Fi
prompt: A four-sword combo attacking to the right, then recovery. First sink into a bent-knee guard and coil hips and shoulders, drawing both hands back. Drive the green held sword through a broad rising diagonal cut into the space in front, pivoting the feet and twisting the torso; immediately counter-rotate into a deep forward lunge and sweep the red held sword down across that same target space. Both arms visibly extend and follow through, not merely tilt their weapons. Simultaneously the two independent floating swords launch from BEHIND the shoulders: gold spins forward in a high curving cut, blue follows in a lower sweeping cut across the target to the right. Both floating blades travel well away from the body, turn with their arcs, and remain separately readable. Brief crossed finishing cuts in front, then recoil the arms and return the floating swords behind her. Finish in the low bent-knee fighting guard. Hair and robe follow the turns. Stationary camera, no zoom, no scene change.
